backend/main.mo: Motoko actor with a single public function `submitContactForm` that accepts name, email, and message parameters but performs no action (placeholder for future email/notification logic).
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two completed features: updating the YouTube social media link to https://www.youtube.com/@sanatani-omkar07 in both the Footer and Contact page components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing JSON-formatted summaries of frontend source files including components, pages, hooks, and configuration files with descriptions of their functionality and styling.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a complete design system using OKLCH color values for light and dark modes, including primary, secondary, muted, accent, and sidebar color tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with UTF-8 charset, viewport meta tag, title "KATTAR SANATANI YODHA", Google AdSense script, root div, and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application component using TanStack Router to define seven routes (home, about, programs, philosophy, resources, contact, donate) all wrapped in a Layout component.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with four-column grid layout displaying organization info with logo, quick links, contact details (email and two phone numbers with clickable links), and social media icons including YouTube link to https://www.youtube.com/@sanatani-omkar07.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Hero section with background image overlay, organization name, Sanskrit and Hindi text, two call-to-action buttons (Support Our Mission with scroll behavior, Learn More link), and animated scroll indicator.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout wrapper component that renders Navigation header, main content area with Outlet for child routes, and Footer in a flex column structure.
frontend/src/components/Mission.tsx: Mission section displaying four core values (Devotion, Protection, Knowledge, Unity) in a responsive grid with icons, Hindi heading "हमारा पवित्र मिशन", and Hindi description text.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Sticky navigation header with logo, organization name, responsive desktop/mobile menus for seven routes (including Philosophy), active route highlighting, and hamburger menu toggle for mobile.
frontend/src/components/ProgramCard.tsx: Reusable card component accepting icon, title, and description props, displaying them with hover effects, rounded styling, and primary color accents.
frontend/src/components/SupportOptions.t: Displays a grid of four support options (volunteer, spread awareness, contribute skills, share knowledge) with icons, descriptions, and call-to-action links to the contact page.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that manages the backend actor instance using React Query, creating authenticated or anonymous actors based on Internet Identity state and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useContactForm.ts: Custom hook that handles contact form submission by calling the backend actor's submitContactForm method and managing submission state (loading, success, error).
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for login/logout functionality, managing AuthClient lifecycle and identity state with support for delegation and idle handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Reserved file for React Query hooks that interact with the backend; currently contains only placeholder comments and example structure for future query implementations.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file defining Tailwind configuration, custom CSS variables for a Sanatani-inspired warm color palette (saffron, terracotta, gold), font imports (Cinzel, Cormorant Garamond, Inter), and utility classes for patterns and gradients.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the root App component into the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/About.tsx: About page component displaying the organization's story, purpose, vision, values, and community through a hero section, narrative text, and a grid of principle cards with icons.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact page with a form for submitting messages (using useContactForm hook), contact information cards (email, phone, location), and social media links with submission state handling.
frontend/src/pages/Donate.tsx: Donate page component displaying support options, impact areas with percentage breakdowns (cultural programs, education, community service, heritage preservation), and a transparency commitment section.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page component featuring Hero and Mission sections, a 'What We Do' grid with four highlights (cultural preservation, spiritual education, community building, social service), and a call-to-action section with support/contact buttons.
frontend/src/pages/Philosophy.tsx: Philosophy page explaining Sanatana Dharma principles including eternal nature (शाश्वत प्रकृति), unwavering commitment/devotion (भक्ति योग), and path of action (कर्म का मार्ग) with devotional examples from Hindu tradition.
frontend/src/pages/Programs.tsx: Programs page showcasing six program categories (Vedic study, cultural festivals, youth education, community gatherings, social welfare, heritage preservation) with an impact statistics section displaying community metrics.
frontend/src/pages/Resources.tsx: Resources page providing access to four categories of materials: sacred texts, video lectures, articles/essays, and downloadable materials, each with specific subcategories listed.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color palette (including Sanatani-themed colors like saffron, terracotta, gold), font families (Inter, Cormorant Garamond, Cinzel), custom shadows, animations, and extended theme properties using OKLCH color space.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file for 'Kattar Sanatani Yodha' with two completed features updating YouTube social media links in Footer and Contact page components to https://www.youtube.com/@sanatani-omkar07.
